sources: UNI-ROYAL Thick Film Chip Resistors data sheet V.3 (Feb. 12, 2019), LCSC's copy https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/0a975aaa49b7c97f38a963127be4a823.pdf?productCode=C26113, read 2026-10-31 (one document for the series; it does not print the order code)
order code (section 2–3, p. 2): 0805 = size, W8 = 1/8 W, F = ±1 %, 2204 = 220 × 10^4 Ω = 2.2 MΩ, T = tape and reel, 5 = 5000 pcs, E = lead free
resistance range (section 6, p. 4): 0805 1/8 W at 70 °C, ±1 % for 0.1 Ω ≤ R < 10 MΩ
ratings (section 7, p. 5): 0805 max. working voltage 150 V, overload 300 V, −55 … 155 °C; power derated above 70 °C (section 9, figure 1)
mpn, manufacturer, footprint, jlc_class, pins: EasyEDA library data of C26113 via edakit part import, read 2026-10-31
JLCPCB catalogue (edakit stock --lcsc, 2026-10-31): Extended Part (preferred), 95 083 pcs
notes: 2.2 MΩ bias and pull-down resistor (blocks instrument-buffer, relay-bypass). Library draft, sibling of C17414 and C17408.

verified.datasheet: UNI-ROYAL Thick Film Chip Resistors V.3 (2019-02-12)
checked: order code 0805W8F2204T5E: W8 = 1/8 W, F = ±1 %, 2204 = 2.2 MΩ (p. 2); within the 1 % range of 0805 (p. 4)
open: the power derating above 70 °C ambient (figure 1, p. 5) is a curve – p_max_w is the value up to 70 °C
thick-film excess noise at megohms is not in the data sheet
